name: ENF Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ENF Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2000 and headquartered in Yongin, South Korea, is a global manufacturer and supplier of advanced chemical solutions primarily serving the semiconductor and display manufacturing sectors. The company's product portfolio includes a variety of process chemicals, such as etchants, strippers, thinners, developers, and cleaners. It also offers a comprehensive range of fine chemicals, encompassing monomers and polymers for photoresists, photo acid generators, anti-reflective coating monomers and polymers, various additives, raw materials for hard masks, and binders. Furthermore, ENF Technology produces specialized color pastes tailored for applications in note PCs, large televisions, and wOLED TVs.
